messages:
morgan: quick heads-up — saw a regression on the canary after the new act-quant group tuning landed (group 48 -> 64). latency looks fine but quality metrics drifted on our longform evals. attaching notes.
ci-bot: canary deploy completed for redwood/open-7b-awq-actq-v3 @commit f2a3d. route: canary/region-us-west-2
ashley: ugh. can you paste the exact quant command + a minimal repro? could be seeding or a decode change.
pranav: command we used:
```
./awq_quantize --model open-7b --group-size 64 --act-quant true --seed 1337 --out open-7b-awq-g64
```
quick eval snippet (longform-qa-v2): baseline ppl=12.1 -> awq-g64 ppl=13.0, MRR -0.6%, rouge-L -0.8. Not catastrophic but consistent across prompts.
morgan: noticed the step where latency spiked briefly at step ~120364 in the canary trace, and shortly after outputs started truncating mid-sentence for some longctx prompts.
ashley: truncation + perp bump sounds like KV cache misalignment or attention kernel fallback. did you see any fallback logs?
pranav: grep shows a bunch of kernel-selection warnings around the same window: "using fallback attention kernel for block 3; mismatch seq-len optim". Also observed slightly different top-k token probs in repeated seeds.
leo: pinging infra — canary-host-7 had an OS kernel upgrade yesterday, could be mismatched cuDNN/cuda. @ops-bot can you confirm?
ops-bot: scheduled: checking canary-host-7. GPU driver: 535.86, CUDA runtime: 12.2. Baseline pool nodes report CUDA 11.8. Flagging potential kernel path divergence.
ashley: that would explain different fast-paths being chosen by the runtime. still need to confirm interaction with act-quant.
pranav: ran ablation locally:
- group=48 actq=true => no regression
- group=64 actq=true => regression (ppl +0.9)
- group=64 actq=false => tiny reg (ppl +0.2)
so looks like a multiplicative effect: larger group size amplifies act-quant sensitivity, but kernel path change may be the trigger.
morgan: let's pause the canary rollout. plan:
1) repro on a node with CUDA 11.8 and CUDA 12.2 to see path diffs
2) run group sweep [48,56,60,64] with seeds [1337,2024]
3) add extra evals: conv-instruct-sanity + longform-qa-v2
4) capture full kernel-selection logs and attention-fallback counts
ashley: add a short smoke that decodes deterministically with topk=1 to isolate sampling noise.
pranav: spawning 4 jobs now; will post summarized CSV. ETA ~25m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
pranav: quick update — results in S3: https://redwood.s3/internal/awq-actq/runoff-3789012345/results.csv
summary: group56 ~= baseline, group60 marginal but within noise, group64 confirmed regression across both seeds. nodes with CUDA12.2 had larger regression than CUDA11.8.
morgan: thanks — that's actionable. next steps: revert canary, mark act-quant+group>=64 as blocked until we either force kernel parity or adjust runtime kernel selection heuristics. filing an issue for runtime to add explicit guard.
ashley: thanks all. please add the repro commands and minimal datasets to the issue so we can triage faster. :thumbsup:
_meta_note: This thread is a short-form Slack thread capturing an AWQ act-quant stability/regression investigation. Messages are chronological and kept concise to match real Slack style.
